sections.title: RAPID OPS COMPANY
sections.body:
**Semper Primus**

This handbook covers what's expected in ROC. If something isn't in here, ask Command.

ROC runs on trust, not paperwork. There's no application to join and no long list of regulations to memorize. Just a few rules that keep this fair and enjoyable for everyone.

You're expected to hold up your end: respect the people you're playing with, respect the mission, and don't make Command chase you to enforce basic decency.

sections.title: 01  ·  RESPECT EVERYONE
sections.body:
> No harassment, no personal attacks, no targeting people outside the server.
> Banter's fine. Don't make it personal.

**Warning, then removal if it continues.**

sections.title: 02  ·  ZERO TOLERANCE ON SLURS
sections.body:
> No exceptions for jokes, context, or bypassing filters with spaces or symbols.

**Immediate removal. No warning.**

sections.title: 03  ·  13+ ONLY
sections.body: > This is Discord's own rule. We enforce it too.

sections.title: 04  ·  NO MALICIOUS LINKS OR DOXXING
sections.body:
> Sharing someone's personal info without consent, or posting harmful links.

**Immediate ban. Non-negotiable.**

sections.title: 05  ·  RESPECT THE MISSION
sections.body:
> Don't sabotage ops, teamkill for fun, or grief teammates in-game.
> Bad calls happen. Malicious ones get you removed.

sections.title: 06  ·  MIC ON, MIC RESPECTFUL
sections.body:
> No music blasting, no screaming over comms, no talking over whoever's running the op.

**Warning, then mute if it continues.**

sections.title: 07 to 09  ·  KEEP IT CLEAN
sections.body:
**Keep drama in DMs.** Beef between two people stays between two people. Don't drag it into general or into an op.

**No DM advertising.** No unsolicited server ads, here or in DMs to our members.

**Command has final say.** If Command or 2iC makes a call mid-op, it stands. Disagree after, in DMs, not during.

sections.title: 10  ·  NO APPLICATION, NO FREE PASS
sections.body:
> You joined easy. That's the deal.
> Repeated no-shows, disruption, or breaking rule 01 or 02 gets you removed.

sections.title: ENFORCEMENT
sections.body:
Command and 2iC handle enforcement directly, case by case. At our size there's no formal appeals board and no infraction point system.

Small stuff gets a warning first. Serious stuff doesn't.

If you think a call was wrong, bring it up in DMs, not in the moment.
